description: Source code for a networking echo server using Zephyr RTOS, implementing TCP/UDP server start/stop, event handling, and TLS setup.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Gives the quit semaphore to signal application termination.

methods.name: start_udp_and_tcp
methods.description: Starts TCP and UDP services if enabled.

methods.name: stop_udp_and_tcp
methods.description: Stops TCP and UDP services if enabled.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Handles network management events such as connection and disconnection.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes application, TLS credentials, event callbacks, VLAN, tunnel, and USB.

methods.name: cmd_sample_quit
methods.description: Shell command to set quit flag and trigger application shutdown.
